wheel.title: Auto Development Wheel
wheel.subtitle: 500,000 lightweight logical agent IDs rotate through one proposal-only development step each second. It proposes work; it does not edit files, run commands or publish code.
wheel.cycleNote: Real cycles while this local server is running.
wheel.activeWorkerNote: One lightweight worker per tick; these are logical IDs, not separate processes.
wheel.horizonNote: A target horizon, not an uptime guarantee.
wheel.controlsNote: Every cycle creates one review proposal. AI API calls and automatic code changes do not run every second.
